items.title: 8.10 Position of equilibrium and reaction conditions

source_refs.note: Topic 8.10, printed page 179. The print's two bullets state the directions the opposite way round; the lesson gives the conventional sense.

blocks.text: The position of equilibrium is the relative amounts of products and reactants in an equilibrium mixture. When a system at equilibrium is disturbed, the position may move: if the concentration of products rises relative to the reactants the position has shifted to the right; if the concentration of products falls relative to the reactants it has shifted to the left.
